description: The line plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates the variation in accuracy (Pass@8) across different temperature values for two methods: On-policy RL (orange line with triangle markers) and SFT (teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers). The x-axis, labeled “Temperature,” spans from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick labels every 2.5 units. The On-policy RL line begins at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, rises sharply to 70.0 at 0.2, fluctuates between 67.5 and 72.5 through 0.6, dips to 67.0 at 0.7, then peaks at 75.0 at 0.8 before declining to 71.0 at 0.9 and rising again to 73.5 at 1.0. The SFT line starts at 76.0 at 0.1, decreases to 75.0 at 0.2, remains relatively stable around 74.5–75.0 until 0.5, drops to 70.0 at 0.6, rises to 76.0 at 0.7, dips to 72.0 at 0.8, falls to 71.0 at 0.9, and recovers to 74.5 at 1.0. A third line, marked with red stars and labeled “On-policy RL” in the legend (though visually distinct from the orange line), begins at 76.0 at 0.1, peaks at 79.0 at 0.2, dips to 76.0 at 0.3, rises to 77.5 at 0.5, peaks again at 80.0 at 0.8, dips to 78.0 at 0.9, and ends at 80.5 at 1.0 — this line appears to represent a different variant or run of On-policy RL, possibly with higher performance. All lines are connected with solid lines and use distinct markers for visual differentiation.
